description: Header file defining the RpmCalculator class and related constants, enums, and function prototypes for engine RPM calculation and shaft position sensing in an automotive firmware project.

classes.name: RpmCalculator
classes.description: Class responsible for calculating and managing engine RPM state based on trigger events and shaft position sensors.

methods.name: isStopped
methods.description: Checks if the engine RPM is zero, indicating the engine is not spinning.

methods.name: isSpinningUp
methods.description: Checks if the engine is in the spinning up state.

methods.name: isCranking
methods.description: Checks if the engine is in cranking state.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the engine is running and not cranking.

methods.name: checkIfSpinning
methods.description: Determines if the engine shaft is spinning based on trigger timing.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current spinning state of the engine.

methods.name: setSpinningUp
methods.description: Marks the engine as starting to spin up.

methods.name: getRpm
methods.description: Returns the current RPM value, considering mock RPM if applicable.

methods.name: onNewEngineCycle
methods.description: Updates RPM calculations after each engine cycle.

methods.name: getRevolutionCounter
methods.description: Returns the total number of shaft revolutions since start.

methods.name: setRpmValue
methods.description: Sets the RPM value and updates internal state.

methods.name: assignRpmValue
methods.description: Assigns RPM value without changing state, used internally.

methods.name: getRevolutionCounterSinceStart
methods.description: Returns the number of revolutions since engine start.

methods.name: getRpmAcceleration
methods.description: Calculates the rate of change of RPM.

methods.name: rpmShaftPositionCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked on shaft trigger events to update RPM.

methods.name: getCrankshaftAngleNt
methods.description: Returns the crankshaft angle at a given timestamp.

methods.name: scheduleByAngle
methods.description: Schedules a callback to occur at a specific crankshaft angle.
